tenant-isolation.redisInjectivityGuard: explicit comment guards a/b+c vs a+b/c collision via escaping
tenant-isolation.notes: REDIS SIDE CORRECT — every key embeds escaped tenant, no cross-tenant collision. IPC SIDE GAP — child launched with only 'roomId gameId'; RoomRpcRequest/Response carry Player/Command/Sequence/snapshots but NO TenantId or RoomKey; RemoteGameRoom keyed by RoomId alone. Tenant isolation across IPC is enforced ENTIRELY on the parent (which holds tenant context and owns proxy/channel pairing). Sound only while the parent never multiplexes two tenants' rooms over one channel and never reuses a child across tenants. No in-band tenant tag means a routing mis-wire could not be detected at the boundary.

atomicity.claimScript: GET owner -> claim only if unowned||ours, SET PX + ZADD in one EVAL
atomicity.mutualExclusion: single round-trip atomic claim prevents split-brain; OwnedCount = ZCARD of un-expired members (no reaper)

gaps: HIGHEST-VALUE FINDING: IPC envelope (RoomRpcRequest/Response) carries no TenantId/RoomKey — RemoteGameRoom is keyed by RoomId alone. Cross-tenant isolation on the IPC boundary rests entirely on parent-side wiring discipline with no in-band tag to catch a mis-wire. Recommend a defensive RoomKey/TenantId field on the envelope.
